tagline: Post Linear issue updates to dev Discord channels automatically
metaTitle: Linear Discord Integration: Issue Alerts in Your Server
metaDescription: Post Linear issue assignments to DMs, urgent alerts and blockers to the channels and sprint wins to the team. GAIA keeps the noise down. See the setup steps.
intro:
Engineering teams that use Discord as their primary communication platform often miss Linear updates because important context stays siloed in the issue tracker. An issue moving to Blocked has no way to interrupt the conversation. A sprint completing with a great velocity goes unannounced. New issues assigned to engineers sit unread while the team chats.

GAIA brings Linear updates into the team's chat by routing the right events to the right channels automatically. High-priority issues get announced in the engineering channel. Blockers alert the relevant team leads. Sprint completions trigger automated summaries. Engineers can even create and update issues directly from chat commands without switching tools.

This integration is particularly valuable for remote-first engineering teams that treat Discord as their virtual office and want issue activity to surface there naturally rather than requiring constant tab-switching.

useCases.title: Post issue assignments to personal Discord DMs
useCases.description: When an issue is assigned to an engineer, GAIA sends them a Discord DM with the issue title, priority, description, and a direct link so they are notified immediately in the tool they are already using.

useCases.title: Announce sprint completions to the engineering channel
useCases.description: When a Linear cycle ends, GAIA posts a formatted sprint summary to the designated channel showing issues completed, carry-over, team velocity, and top contributors to celebrate the team's work.

useCases.title: Alert the team to new high-priority issues
useCases.description: When an issue is created or upgraded to Urgent priority, GAIA immediately posts an alert to the engineering channel with full context so the team can react and assign it without delay.

useCases.title: Post blocker alerts to the leads channel
useCases.description: When an issue transitions to Blocked, GAIA sends a structured alert to the team leads channel including the blocking dependency, the affected engineer, and the issue's current due date so blockers are resolved quickly.

useCases.title: Create Linear issues from Discord commands
useCases.description: Engineers can type a GAIA command to create a new issue without leaving the chat. GAIA prompts for title, priority, and assignee, creates the issue, and posts the confirmation link back to the channel.

howItWorks.step: Connect Linear and Discord to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Linear workspace and invite the GAIA bot to your Discord server. Map teams to channels during setup.

howItWorks.step: Configure notification rules and channel routing
howItWorks.description: Choose which events generate notifications, which channels should receive which event types, and the format of notification messages.

howItWorks.step: Issue activity reaches the channels automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA watches the workspace for the configured events and posts formatted updates to the right channels in real time. The team stays informed without leaving the chat.

faqs.question: Can GAIA send Linear notifications to different channels based on the team or project?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure channel routing rules so that Team A notifications go to #team-alpha and Team B notifications go to #team-beta. You can also route by event type, priority, or label.

faqs.question: Can engineers interact with issues directly from Discord?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA supports slash commands for common actions including creating issues, updating status, adding comments, and querying the current sprint state. Responses are posted in-thread so the channel stays clean.

faqs.question: How does GAIA handle notification fatigue?
faqs.answer: You control the event filters. Most teams configure GAIA to notify only on priority thresholds (e.g., Urgent and High only), specific labels, or specific issue state transitions rather than every event. This keeps the signal-to-noise ratio high.
